# What is the default for automation writes?
Agents can push, open pull requests, move tickets and comment.

Options:
1. All off. Each write waits for one click in Home / Inbox. An admin turns each one on per project. (recommended)
2. Comments and transitions on, push and pull requests off.
3. All on.

## Answer
All off. Each write waits for one click in Home / Inbox. An admin turns each one on per project.
